expected: 200; bounded score and nonempty AI feedback for unrelated role

action_plan: Include these role-specific keywords naturally in skills and project bullets: seek, graphic, designer, experienced, typography.
Rewrite the top 2 project bullets so they directly mirror this job's responsibilities.
Add metrics to at least 3 bullets using a format like: improved X by Y% / reduced Z by Y hours.

interview_focus: Candidate must provide concrete examples of any design work, even if non-professional, to demonstrate potential for a graphic designer role.
